name: Aki
source: Aki, who had become a delinquent as a protest against her intelligent [url=/c108196]older sister[/url], seriously reassessed her future and realized that she could not follow down that path. Aki is a smart girl by nature, so she is now studying hard to enroll in a university.
translation: Aki, who had become a delinquent as a protest against her intelligent [url=/c108196]older sister[/url], seriously reassessed her future and realized that she could not follow down that path. Aki is a smart girl by nature, so she is now studying hard to enroll in a university.
